## Accepted periodic {2,3} sandpile partial, attempt 1/5

Problem 20000976 / AIM-COMBINATORICS-0101. For P×Q-periodic square-grid backgrounds taking only heights 2 and 3, explosion from some finite origin source occurs exactly when every cell row and column contains a 3. The cell scan takes O(PQ), and the proof supplies the nonsharp source bound 4^(ceil((P−1)/2)+ceil((Q−1)/2)+1).

The full analytic proof retains least action, explicit one-direction integer tent barriers, the finite seed and face-propagation argument credited to Fey–Levine–Peres, the signed-adjugate conversion of full-rank lattice input, the decidable periodic integer-potential certificate extension, bounded-potential source-threshold invariance, and the exact infinite-avalanche stripe example.

Pointwise stabilization is strictly distinguished from finite total topplings. A single deficient-line family gives the pointwise conclusion only. The full periodic {0,1,2,3} decision remains unresolved by this work; no undecidability, density classification, exhaustive potential reduction, novelty or priority claim is made.

## Publication boundary and review limits

Exactly seven authored proof, audit, acceptance, status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000976/`. All mathematical arguments and qualifications are preserved. Editorial changes remove private workflow provenance, rebind the distributed proof/audit identities, and retain aggregate supporting check totals only. No proof correction is required for the accepted partial claims.

Programs, fixtures, detailed computational output, datasets, copied source documents or text, source-derived images and private coordination material are excluded. There is no omitted-file dependency. The edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed; scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Source retrieval/inspection and aggregate check totals are recorded historical observations. Edition preparation makes no fresh scholarly retrieval, source rehash, source inspection, literature-search or computational-rerun claim.

QUEUE.md and all unrelated entries are unchanged. This is partial attempt 1/5; editorial preparation adds no proof turn and does not reset accounting. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
